fields.q: 比起鱼那种空洞无神、什么都映不出的眼睛，我更偏爱鸟的脸。呃！
fields.en: I'm partial to birds' faces, not like fishes', with those soulless eyes. Mirrors reflecting nothing. Gah!
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 比起鱼那种空洞无神、什么都映不出的眼睛，我更偏爱鸟的脸。呃！

en.value: I'm partial to birds' faces, not like fishes', with those soulless eyes. Mirrors reflecting nothing. Gah!

fields.q: 酒能给体验增添色彩，让任何对话都焕发新意！你不这么认为吗？
fields.en: Intoxicants add color to one's experiences, bring out a new side to any conversation! Don't you agree?
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 酒能给体验增添色彩，让任何对话都焕发新意！你不这么认为吗？

en.value: Intoxicants add color to one's experiences, bring out a new side to any conversation! Don't you agree?

fields.q: 我在自然美景环绕的家中长大，每天早上都被鸟鸣唤醒。
fields.en: I grew up in a home surrounded by natural beauty, where I awoke each morning to birdsong.
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 我在自然美景环绕的家中长大，每天早上都被鸟鸣唤醒。

en.value: I grew up in a home surrounded by natural beauty, where I awoke each morning to birdsong.

fields.q: 我来给你朗读家父艾尼阿斯的杰作吧。连你这颗鸟儿的心都能打动！
fields.en: I will read you the masterpiece by my father Aeneus. It's powerful enough to move even your avian heart!
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 我来给你朗读家父艾尼阿斯的杰作吧。连你这颗鸟儿的心都能打动！

en.value: I will read you the masterpiece by my father Aeneus. It's powerful enough to move even your avian heart!

fields.q: 要是有你这样的翅膀，我就能立刻飞到任何想研究的题材那里。想想看！
fields.en: Had I wings like yours, I could fly at once to any research subject I wanted. Imagine it!
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 要是有你这样的翅膀，我就能立刻飞到任何想研究的题材那里。想想看！

en.value: Had I wings like yours, I could fly at once to any research subject I wanted. Imagine it!

fields.q: 可惜你不会说人话。你一定有很多故事可讲。
fields.en: It's too bad you don't speak any human languages. I'm sure you'd have tales to tell.
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 可惜你不会说人话。你一定有很多故事可讲。

en.value: It's too bad you don't speak any human languages. I'm sure you'd have tales to tell.

fields.q: 啊，我太爱城市了。坐着就能看尽喧嚣、混乱与狂欢！
fields.en: Ahh, how I adore the city. You can sit back and witness the bustle, the confusion, the ecstasy!
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 啊，我太爱城市了。坐着就能看尽喧嚣、混乱与狂欢！

en.value: Ahh, how I adore the city. You can sit back and witness the bustle, the confusion, the ecstasy!

fields.q: 神殿给了我好多故事灵感！这么说来，神殿真是慷慨的赞助人。
fields.en: Through the temples, I've been given so many story ideas! In that way the temples are a generous patron.
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 神殿给了我好多故事灵感！这么说来，神殿真是慷慨的赞助人。

en.value: Through the temples, I've been given so many story ideas! In that way the temples are a generous patron.

fields.q: 我上一部作品是杰作，但下一部会更好。没错！因为我一直在进步。
fields.en: My last work was a masterpiece, but my next will be even better. Yes! For I am always improving.
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 我上一部作品是杰作，但下一部会更好。没错！因为我一直在进步。

en.value: My last work was a masterpiece, but my next will be even better. Yes! For I am always improving.

fields.q: 每当沉思时，就有个恶魔嘲笑我没有才华。你也听过它的声音吗？
fields.en: In moments of reflection, a demon taunts me, telling me I have no talent. Have you heard its voice too?
fields.name: 丹提

q.value: 每当沉思时，就有个恶魔嘲笑我没有才华。你也听过它的声音吗？
